text: TREEDATA 1001-1006, 24 little-endian words each, in the order of the Type list (Maple, Elm, Pine, Poplar, Sapling) and a sixth.

Read here as: 0-1 most/fewest branches, 2 the level leaves start at, 3 depth, then (value, variation) pairs: 4-5 spread and upward pull, 6-7 thickness, 8-9 length ratio, 10-11 trunk, 12-15 leaf size and density, 16-19 colour mix. That reading is a guess from how the numbers differ between the trees; the code that used them was not decompiled.
